summary: Part 1 of 5 (00:00 to 06:52) of the "11.0 Dashboard (KAMs)" training: a tour of the Supply dashboard for KAMs. It covers the tab bar, the top-right buttons, the chart/table switch, the index and filters, the methodology fold, and then the Daily tab sections Meetings, Legal, Buybox closed and Late orders, with the rules for colours, targets and what to do. Adversarial check: 13 of the 40 listed frames were opened and compared with the claims (t00000, t00024, t00048, t00097, t00129, t00153, t00208, t00259, t00310, t00344, t00360, t00378, t00404). Frame t00097 was cited for the KAM tab but shows the Daily tab, so those claims were downgraded. Speech recognition errors were fixed from on-screen labels. Meeting counts change between frames (100 vs 95), so those are logged as unclear rather than stated as facts.
